body: Support 1-to-4 slash-delimited conversationId segments (e.g. v1/default/jetski_remote_agents_3p_devbox/<uuid>) in hooks/policy/paths.mjs (walking every segment in verifyBrainArtifactDirectory for zero symlinks) and hooks/lifecycle.mjs (flat hash-suffixed session-state file keys). Accept terminationReason === 'model_stop' || terminationReason === 'NO_TOOL_CALL' in hooks/lifecycle.mjs Stop handler. Classify App/Web/Remote built-in tools in hooks/policy/constants.mjs and hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs: read-only google_search, browse, google:browse, list_skills, lookup_skill, lookup_skills, get_skill_resources (blocking traversal in filenames) and external/customization-mutating create_github_repository, fork_github_repository, detach_github_repository, save_skill, update_skill, delete_skill (forceAsk interactively, deny in headless/readonly). Update lib/brain.mjs to include .gemini/antigravity-ide/brain, scan up to 4 levels for jetski brain dirs, support multi-segment session IDs in writePlanArtifact, and strip HTML tags from Mermaid node labels. Add tests in test/lifecycle-hooks.test.mjs, test/pre-tool-use.test.mjs, and test/cli-nextgen.test.mjs.
title: jetski conversationId, Stop model_stop, PreToolUse Taxonomy & Brain Parity
